verdict.rationale: Identity walls on sign-in are a fair question for a state business-filing portal, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no sign-in path, account login, or MFA method of any kind. It shows only that online filings are paid by card or a prepaid E-File Account and that typing a name in the signature block suffices. Those are filing mechanics, not a published credential-MFA sign-in, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
